title: 第9章 不信

content_zh:
杨厚承站在乔昭身后，轻轻咳嗽了一声，提醒小姑娘别乱说话。
真惹恼了那家伙，他可不管男女老幼，照样赶下船去的，到时候小姑娘岂不可怜。
朱彦温声提醒道：“学过画的人都会画鸭，可这‘会’和‘会’是不同的——”
乔昭弯了弯唇：“朱大哥，我懂。”
她说完，又看向池灿，语气平静但满是诚意：“我给池大哥画一副鸭戏图，就当答谢池大哥的援手之恩。”
池灿本就心烦，乔昭的诚意落在他眼里，就成了不知天高地厚的狂妄。
他紧紧盯着她，不怒反笑，语气却是冷冰冰的：“那好，你画吧。”
他顿了顿，接着说了一句：“若是让我交不了差，等船中途靠岸你就给我下船去！”
“拾曦——”朱彦轻轻拍了拍他，“这是不是有些……”
不近人情？
朱彦到底没把这四个字说出口。
三人是自小玩到大的，他当然明白好友的脾气。
长公主与驸马的事让池灿性情改变不少，但那时还不至于如此偏激。随着池灿年龄渐长，风姿越发出众，麻烦就越来越多了。
他还清楚记得，有一次池灿好心救了一位被恶霸调戏的姑娘，那姑娘死活要跟池灿回府，池灿自是拒绝，没想到转天那姑娘就在长公主府门外的树上上了吊，还留言生是池灿的人，死是池灿的鬼。
好事不出门，坏事传千里，此事瞬间传遍了京城大街小巷，到后来谁还记得池灿救人，都在议论定是他勾了人家姑娘，结果不认账，才害那姑娘寻死的。
那年池灿才十三岁，人言可畏，如一座大山压得少年喘不过气来，而他的母亲长容长公主则拿起鞭子，赏了儿子一身鞭痕。
自此之后，池灿性情就日渐乖戾起来。
说实话，那日黎三向好友求救竟没被拒绝，他都觉得惊讶。
朱彦轻叹一声。
罢了，黎姑娘若真被赶下船去，大不了他暗中关照一下，总不能让小姑娘真的没法回家。

“你们都别掺合，这是她自找的。”池灿冷冰冰道。
女人就是这样，从三岁到八十岁，贪婪、虚荣、狂妄、没有自知之明……
池灿心中瞬间划过十几个形容词，娴熟无比。
乔昭眨了眨眼。
这人和她印象中不大一样。
那时候他明明只是脸皮厚，看不出这么刻薄小气呀。
“原来池大哥施恩不图报。”乔昭说了一句。
池灿眯了眼，一时有些不解她的意思。
朱彦旁观者清，略一思索便听明白了，不由低笑一声。
杨厚承拉朱彦一下，低声问道：“打什么哑谜呢？”
朱彦摇头不语。
池灿看了二人一眼，再看表情波澜不惊的乔昭，忽然明白过来。
小丫头是说，他本来就答应带她回京的，她出于报恩替他作画反而有了被赶下船的风险，可见他不求她报答。
所以，这其实是在讽刺他为人刻薄吧？
池灿不由狠狠瞪了小姑娘一眼。
这丫头有十三岁吗？现在就这么一肚子弯弯绕绕的心肠，说句话都要人琢磨半天，以后还了得！
乔昭颇为冤枉，一双黑白分明的眸子望着池灿。
她只是实话实说而已，怎么又招白眼了？
池灿别过眼，冷笑道：“现在后悔也晚了，爷等着你画呢。”
乔昭现在尤其听不得“爷”这个字，压下心中不悦道：“我祖父早已过世啦。”

池灿一怔，随后大怒，伸手指着乔昭：“你——”
“你”了半天，见她眼圈泛红，愣是一句话也憋不出来。
朱彦和杨厚承听出乔昭有意埋汰池灿，偏偏埋汰得巧妙，让人有火发不出，忍不住低笑起来。
池灿听了更生气了。
乔昭脸皮素来不薄，此刻又顶着一张青涩的脸，就更无所谓了，淡定问道：“船上可有笔墨颜料等物？”
“都有，我带你去吧。”朱彦怕气氛太僵，主动领着乔昭进了船舱客房。
这艘客船本来能载客十数人，三人财大气粗，出手包了下来，便腾出一间客房专门充作书房。
乔昭随着朱彦进入，环视一眼，屋内布置虽简单，该有的书案、矮榻等物却一样不少。
“这些笔墨纸砚你都可以随意用。”朱彦一边领着她往内走一边道，“只是这些书不要乱翻，不然又要惹得拾曦生气。”

content_en:
Yang Houcheng stood behind Qiao Zhao, coughed slightly, and reminded the little girl not to talk nonsense.
I really pissed off that guy, but he still rushed off the boat regardless of age or sex. Wouldn't the little girl be pitiful then?
Zhu Yan reminded him warmly: "Anyone who has learned painting can draw ducks, but there is a difference between 'hui' and 'hui' -"
Qiao Zhao curled his lips: "Brother Zhu, I understand."
After she finished speaking, she looked at Chi Can again, her tone calm but full of sincerity: "I drew a picture of a duck scene for Brother Chi, as a way of thanking Brother Chi for his help."
Chi Can was already upset, but in his eyes, Qiao Zhao's sincerity turned into arrogance.
He stared at her closely, smiling instead of angry, but his tone was cold: "Okay, you draw it."
He paused and then said: "If I can't deliver the job, you can get off the ship when the ship docks halfway!"
"Shi Xi——" Zhu Yan patted him gently, "Isn't this a bit..."
Unkind?
Zhu Yan never said these four words.
The three of them have been playing together since childhood, so of course he understands his friend's temper.
The incident between the eldest princess and the consort made Chi Can's temperament change a lot, but it was not so extreme at that time. As Chi Can gets older and his charm becomes more outstanding, the troubles increase.
He still clearly remembered that one time Chi Can kindly rescued a girl who was molested by a bully. The girl wanted to go back to the house with Chi Can, but Chi Can refused. Unexpectedly, the next day the girl hanged herself on a tree outside the eldest princess' house, leaving a message that she was Chi Can's person in life and Chi Can's ghost in death.
Good things don't go out, but bad things spread thousands of miles. This incident spread all over the streets and alleys of the capital in an instant. Afterwards, whoever remembered Chi Can's rescue was talking about the fact that he must have seduced the girl and then refused to admit it, causing the girl to seek death.
Chi Can was only thirteen years old that year, and he was so formidable that he was weighed down by a huge mountain that made the boy breathless. His mother, Princess Changrong, picked up the whip and rewarded her son with whip marks all over his body.
Since then, Chi Can's temperament has become increasingly surly.
To be honest, he was surprised that Li San's request for help from his friend was not rejected that day.
Zhu Yan sighed softly.
Forget it, if Miss Li is really driven off the boat, the worst he can do is take care of her secretly so that the little girl can't really go home.
"Don't get involved, she asked for it." Chi Can said coldly.
Women are like this, from the age of three to eighty, they are greedy, vain, arrogant, and have no self-awareness...
A dozen adjectives flashed across Chi Can's mind in an instant, extremely skillful.
Qiao Zhao blinked.
This man was different from what she remembered.
At that time, he was obviously just thick-skinned and could not be seen as being so mean and stingy.
"It turns out that Brother Chi doesn't want to repay his kindness." Qiao Zhao said.
Chi Can narrowed his eyes and was a little confused about what she meant.
Zhu Yan was a clear observer, and he understood after a moment's thought, and couldn't help but chuckle.
Yang Houcheng pulled Zhu Yan and asked in a low voice: "What kind of riddle are you playing?"
Zhu Yan shook his head and said nothing.
Chi Can glanced at the two of them, then looked at Qiao Zhao with a calm expression, and suddenly understood.
The little girl said that he had promised to take her back to Beijing, but she painted for him out of repayment and risked being kicked off the ship. This shows that he did not ask her to repay him.
So, this is actually a satire on him for being mean, right?
Chi Can couldn't help but glare at the little girl.
Is this girl thirteen years old? Now I have such a crooked heart that I have to think about every word for a long time, but I will be able to pay it back in the future!
Qiao Zhao was quite unjust and looked at Chi Can with a pair of black and white eyes.
She was just telling the truth, so why was she looking at her blankly again?
Chi Can looked away and sneered: "It's too late to regret now, I'm waiting for you to draw."
Qiao Zhao especially couldn't hear the word "Master" now. He suppressed his displeasure and said, "My grandfather has passed away long ago."
Chi Can was stunned for a moment, then became furious and pointed at Qiao Zhao: "You——"
"you"After waiting for a long time, I saw her eyes were red and she was so stunned that she couldn't hold back a word.
Zhu Yan and Yang Houcheng couldn't help laughing when they heard that Qiao Zhao intended to bury Chican, but he did it so cleverly that it made people angry.
Chi Can became even more angry after hearing this.
Qiao Zhao had never been thin-skinned, and now he had a green face, so he didn't care anymore. He asked calmly: "Are there pens, inks, paints, etc. on the ship?"
"All of them, I'll take you there." Zhu Yan was afraid that the atmosphere would be too tense, so he took the initiative to lead Qiao Zhao into the cabin.
This passenger ship could originally carry more than ten passengers. The three people were very wealthy, so they rented it out and freed up a guest room to be used as a study.
Qiao Zhao followed Zhu Yan into the room and took a look around. Although the layout of the room was simple, there were still a lot of books, tables, couches and other things that should be there.
"You can use these pens, inks, papers and inkstones as you like." Zhu Yan said as he led her inside, "Just don't read these books randomly, otherwise you will make Shi Xi angry again."
